name: firecrawl-cli
description: CLI wrapping the Firecrawl hosted API (api.firecrawl.dev) for general web search and JS-rendering page scrape. Fills two gaps the other portal skills don't cover: searching job boards without a dedicated CLI (Naukri, FoundIt, ...) and rendering client-side-rendered posting pages (Workday, Ashby, Greenhouse-embedded) that return empty from a plain fetch. Requires FIRECRAWL_API_KEY.
